language.name: English
reason.unknown: The companion refused this for a reason it has no sentence for yet: {token}.
profile.chat_qa.name: Chat Q&A
profile.chat_qa.description: Answers a chat message that mentions the companion's name.
profile.channel_points.name: Channel points
profile.channel_points.description: Reacts when a viewer redeems one custom reward you choose.
profile.spoken_keyword.name: Spoken keyword
profile.spoken_keyword.description: Listens to your microphone and answers when you say the wake word.
profile.silent.name: Silent
profile.silent.description: Connects to your channel's chat but never answers: every trigger is off.
instance.already_running: The companion is already running for this profile; opening it: {url}
instance.version_mismatch: Another version of the companion is already running for this profile: version {running} is running, and this launch is version {own}. Nothing was opened.
instance.version_mismatch.next: Close the running companion window and launch again, or open the running one manually at {url}
instance.record_exists: An instance record exists for this profile: {path}
instance.port.unauthenticated: Its recorded port {port} answers, but the check with the record's access token did not succeed.
instance.port.silent: Its recorded port {port} did not answer within 10 seconds.
instance.not_confirmed.cause: The companion that wrote the record may still be starting or stopping, or another program now uses that port, so this launch started nothing.
instance.not_confirmed.next: Use the companion window if one is open; otherwise wait and launch again, and if this report repeats, close the program holding process {pid} or restart the computer.
instance.unconfirmable: Its process {pid} is running but not answering to this launch: this platform cannot confirm that it is the companion, so this launch started nothing.
instance.unconfirmable.next: Use the companion window if one is open, on 127.0.0.1 port {port}; otherwise close the program holding process {pid} or restart the computer.
instance.stale: An earlier instance of the companion did not stop cleanly; its instance record was removed.
instance.unusable: The instance record {path} could not be read or written, so the companion did not start.
instance.unusable.next: Keep the profile on a local disk you can write to, then launch again.
platform.connected: Connected: the token names the Twitch channel {login}.
platform.connection_refused: The companion could not reach Twitch to check the access token.
platform.connection_refused.next: Check that this computer is connected to the internet, then select Check again.
platform.timeout: Twitch did not answer the token check within {seconds} seconds.
platform.timeout.next: Wait a moment and select Check again; if it keeps happening, check your internet connection.
platform.unauthorized: Twitch refused this access token: it is not valid, or it has expired.
platform.unauthorized.next: Generate a new access token for the account the companion speaks as, paste it, then select Check again.
platform.client_id_mismatch: This access token belongs to a different application than the client id you entered.
platform.client_id_mismatch.next: Paste the client id of the application that generated this token, or generate a new token with this client id.
platform.missing_scope: This access token lacks permissions this profile needs: {scopes}.
platform.missing_scope.next: Generate a new access token that grants every permission listed, paste it, then select Check again.
platform.malformed_answer: Twitch answered the token check with something the companion could not read.
platform.malformed_answer.next: Wait a moment and select Check again; nothing was changed.
rewards.connection_refused: The companion could not reach Twitch to read your channel's rewards.
rewards.connection_refused.next: Check that this computer is connected to the internet, then select Check again.
rewards.timeout: Twitch did not send your channel's rewards within {seconds} seconds.
rewards.timeout.next: Wait a moment and select Check again; if it keeps happening, check your internet connection.
rewards.unauthorized: Twitch refused to list your channel's rewards with this access token.
rewards.unauthorized.next: Generate the access token with the broadcaster's account, paste it, then select Check again.
rewards.malformed_answer: Twitch answered the reward list with something the companion could not read.
rewards.malformed_answer.next: Wait a moment and select Check again; nothing was changed.
rewards.no_rewards: Your channel has no custom channel-points reward yet.
rewards.no_rewards.next: Create the reward first in your Twitch creator dashboard, then select Check again.
model.answered: The model answered a real request.
model.not_needed: This profile never asks the model anything, so no model is needed.
model.connection_refused: The companion could not reach the model at the address you entered.
model.connection_refused.next: Check the endpoint address and that the model server is running, then select Check again.
model.timeout: The model did not answer within {seconds} seconds.
model.timeout.next: Check that the model is loaded and not busy, then select Check again.
model.unauthorized: The model endpoint refused the API key.
model.unauthorized.next: Paste a valid API key for this endpoint, then select Check again.
model.not_found: The model endpoint answered that this address or this model does not exist.
model.not_found.next: Check the endpoint address (a chat-completions address) and the model name, then select Check again.
model.not_a_completion: The address answered, but not with a chat completion.
model.not_a_completion.next: Enter the full address of a chat-completions endpoint, then select Check again.
model.empty_answer: The model answered with an empty text.
model.empty_answer.next: Choose another model or check the model's settings, then select Check again.
